system.summary: 6x6 digit square, each letter a vertical pair of digits 1-6 (top over bottom), with some thirty graphic signs for words or names.
system.notes: Pair 12 = w in Dutch and final z in French; rare pairs 53, 61-64 probably misreadings. Graphic signs act as a small nomenclator.

prior_solution.where: G. Lasry solved it independently in 2021, unpublished (private communication, 25 Sept 2026). DECODE status non-decrypted; no decipherment on the images

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie supplied, problem posed with /goal. No target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Fetched R1892 images and key records R2240, R2233 with the session cookie.
R2240 (four-digit Orange name key) and R2233: R1892 uses only digits 1-6.
Digits 1-6 written as vertical pairs: a 6x6 Polybius-type square.
Two subagents transcribed page 1 (1039 pairs) and page 2 (790 pairs) as TOP+BOTTOM tokens.
Many-to-one quadgram annealing on the Dutch page: collapsed onto e/n.
One-to-one swap annealing with Dutch quadgrams on page 2: 'het rassemblement te zamen te houden', 'officieren'.
Same square applied to page 1 gives French; 54=q, 14=x, 13=y, 12=z(French) adjusted.
Word signs assigned from decrypted context: circle = de (27, all fit), gamma = zich, c-sign = te, G = ik (probable).
Closing and page 2 line 1 re-read at full resolution: 'à mon frère' (44/54 misreadings of 24/52), 'den generaal Bertincy'; line 24 still unalignable.
Lasry review (email 25 Sept 2026): Lasry wrote that he had independently solved it in 2021 but never published it; kept in the ciphertext-only list with that note.

outcome.method_basis: The 6x6 vertical-digit-pair square was recovered by one-to-one quadgram annealing on the Dutch page 2 and then read the French page 1 unchanged; the Orange keys R2240 and R2233 did not fit, and there is no decipherment on the images.
outcome.fraction_read_source: transcription_p1.txt + transcription_p2.txt with the apply.py key (scratchpad measure_C_orange.py): 1,848 of 1,958 cipher tokens read (digit pairs in the square and the circle-dot DE sign); word signs left as <..>, unmapped pairs and ?? counted unread; <struck>, parentheticals and bracketed clear words excluded. p1 1043/1056, p2 805/902.
outcome.notes: 1816 of 1829 digit pairs mapped; 27 'de' signs read; ~100 other sign occurrences unread or only probable.

gaps.item: about 20 rare word signs (1-4 occurrences each), plus ⊣H and hook (guessed)
gaps.detail: context does not fix them; transcriber labels may merge or split shapes
photocopy; the two digit rows drift and several pairs are ambiguous
